newsitem.title: COMOROS: Bulldozers demolish shops in Comoros capital.
newsitem.headline: Bulldozers demolish shops in Comoros capital.

text.p: Soldiers escorted bulldozers into the centre of Moroni on Saturday to demolish shops and trading stalls as part of a government plan to refurbish the city.
Other traders who have built shops in the area have been given until Monday to leave, to allow their buildings to be removed.
The clearance raised strong protests from the traders, who said they had been given five-year leases by the Moroni prefecture.
Army chief of staff Moilim Djoussouf was quoted on state radio on Saturday night as saying the area was being cleared as part of a scheme to improve the Indian Ocean islands' capital.
Hundreds of hawkers operating in the market area -- mainly poor people from the most heavily populated areas -- have been told to leave, their spokesmen told reporters on Sunday.
